t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Keep your fingers on the keys and use breaks so you don't get tired. There seems to be no pattern based on colour and no connection to the points.

vb_textbox.text: Keep your hands on the S and K keys and the space bar so that you can easily press the keys. Try and choose a pattern so that you stay focused on the task and you do not time out. I tried S,K,S,K or S,S,S,K,K,K. I don't think the colour of the gnomes or where they are makes a difference, just try and be fast!
